races.name: Annual Members At Huntingdon Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
He may well have been no match for an odds-on favourite on his recent hurdling debut, but MY MATE AJ showed plenty to work on, so he gets the verdict to go a place better for the in-form Ben Pauling yard. The obvious danger is Double The Dance, who found one too strong in all 3 bumper starts last season and should make his mark as a hurdler. Talladale may prove best of the rest.

  1. MY MATE AJ (IRE)
  2. DOUBLE THE DANCE (IRE)
  3. TALLADALE

races.name: Christmas Parties At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
It could pay to concentrate on CHICO MAGNIFICA and Tazman Dan here, with Olly Murphy's 4-y-o narrowly preferred now up and running.

  1. CHICO MAGNIFICA (IRE)
  2. TAZMAN DAN (IRE)
  3. MASTER DUNRAVEN (IRE)

races.name: Conferences At Huntingdon 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CRYSTAL ISLAND arrives unbeaten having won an Irish point and both starts over hurdles and he looks the type to go on to even better things as a staying chaser. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Reckless Spending, who also remains with potential as he makes the switch to chasing.

  1. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE)
  2. RECKLESS SPENDING (IRE)
  3. JOHN BARBOUR

races.name: Book Hospitality At Huntingdon Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The tentative nod goes to JAMADA, who made a reasonably encouraging start over fences when fourth at Worcester recently and Olly Murphy's 6-y-o is open to improvement, especially if brushing up his jumping. Inside Man showed much more what he's about when runner-up at Chepstow earlier in the month, so he looks a big threat, with Sweeper System rounding off the shortlist.

  1. JAMADA (IRE)
  2. INSIDE MAN (FR)
  3. SWEEPER SYSTEM (IRE)

races.name: Festive Fiver Raceday 21 December Mares' Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This can go the way of LETS GO MO, who shaped encouragingly switched to a handicap after 8 months off when finding just one too strong at Lingfield recently and Lucy Wadham's filly looks capable of better again. Palma Springs represents a yard firing on all cylinders, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with Bontessony Doll expected to fare better now handicapping over a longer trip.

  1. LETS GO MO (IRE)
  2. PALMA SPRINGS
  3. BONTESSONY DOLL

races.name: Come Racing At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
An open-looking finale that may go the way of handicap debutant LYRICAL CHOICE. The dangers are headed by Moab and Beau Quali, the latter particularly interesting if supported.

  1. LYRICAL CHOICE (IRE)
  2. MOAB (IRE)
  3. BEAU QUALI (FR)

races.name: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
EIGHTY EIGHT built on a promising stable debut to win comfortably at Chelmsford 18 days ago and remains well treated despite a 5 lb rise. Token Love produced his best effort when second over C&D 21 days ago and can again be in the mix, while Beachborough Girl won here in June off this mark.

  1. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE)
  2. TOKEN LOVE (FR)
  3. BEACHBOROUGH GIRL

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
CAPRICIOUS STAR should have more to offer over this longer distance for a yard with a good record with nursery debutants, so gets the vote. Orchard Hatches should also be suited by the step up in trip and is second choice.

  1. CAPRICIOUS STAR (IRE)
  2. ORCHARD HATCHES
  3. PRINCESS LOTTIE

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle - 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS has been off the track since disappointing in June but she's worth another chance to confirm debut promise at Nottingham, which has been massively franked by the first 2. Kodi Morse looks sure to leave his debut behind so is feared, while Geometric and Frontier Run are a couple of newcomers to note.

  1. QUEEN OF CHRISTMAS (IRE)
  2. KODI MORSE (IRE)
  3. GEOMETRIC (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
OUR PLANET justified market confidence when making a winning debut for this yard here on Friday and he's still very well treated under a penalty. It shouldn't be long before Stash The Cash takes advantage of a reduced mark for his up-and-coming handler so rates the main threat ahead of Fancy Dancer, who finished slightly ahead of him here 3 weeks ago.

  1. OUR PLANET (IRE)
  2. STASH THE CASH (IRE)
  3. FANCY DANCER

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
BARACHIEL has been transformed by the switch to handicaps and step up in trip and he looks capable of defying a 6 lb rise given the manner of his C&D win 3 weeks ago. Saxophonist, Seventy and Aleen complete the shortlist.

  1. BARACHIEL (IRE)
  2. SAXOPHONIST (IRE)
  3. SEVENTY

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A well-run race looks in store and RIDGER can strike after a narrow defeat last time. Fellow 3-y-o Dark Mandate has made a positive start with this yard and should be thereabouts, while Montpellier Green can't be ignored from a dangerous mark.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. DARK MANDATE
  3. MONTPELLIER GREEN (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
JAMIE SOMMERS can capitalise on a reduced mark at the expense of Chapman's Peak. The in-form Girls Allowed can't be ignored in her hat-trick bid.

  1. JAMIE SOMMERS (IRE)
  2. CHAPMAN'S PEAK
  3. GIRLS ALLOWED (IRE)

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
MONARCH'S GOLD can take advantage of a career-low mark and gain a first handicap success eased in grade. Pietro is on an attractive mark and should be thereabouts if taking to headgear, while Drifts Away is another to consider.

  1. MONARCH'S GOLD
  2. PIETRO (IRE)
  3. DRIFTS AWAY

races.name: AWC Season 14 Handicap
races.verdict:
SOVEREIGN BAY went like the best horse at the weights when narrowly denied on his yard debut over this C&D 21 days ago. The stable has an excellent record with this type of recruit and he can gain quick compensation. Hitched has won twice over C&D and is feared most after hinting at a revival last time, while Galba will find life tougher under a penalty but is respected.

  1. SOVEREIGN BAY (FR)
  2. HITCHED (IRE)
  3. GALBA

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
JODHPUR BLUE is starting to look very well treated on the pick of this year's form, particularly if Conor Whiteley's claim is taken into account, and he's taken to deny Koko Blue and Molly Keegan-Price a C&D hat-trick. The reliable Golspie is another likely to have a say.

  1. JODHPUR BLUE (FR)
  2. KOKO BLUE
  3. GOLSPIE (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OLD COMPTON makes obvious appeal here on the back of his encouraging opening effort at Newmarket. Good Bye Girl is a newcomer who makes paper appeal. Ed Bethell's Rogue Inferno completes the shortlist.

  1. OLD COMPTON (IRE)
  2. GOOD BYE GIRL (IRE)
  3. ROGUE INFERNO (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
DOWMAN looked good back at 5f on this surface at Southwell last week and can defy a penalty. This is a much more realistic assignment for Big Hitter than the listed race she ran in last time and Jamie Osborne's filly is feared most ahead of shock Catterick maiden winner The Stony Baker.

  1. DOWMAN (IRE)
  2. BIG HITTER (IRE)
  3. THE STONY BAKER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Several interesting newcomers but before any betting clues are known FAITHFUL looks the way to go on the back of a good opening effort at Yarmouth. Ruby Sands should find this easier than the listed race she contested at Newmarket last time. Bintbossom and Angelcatcher are the debutants who make most appeal on paper.

  1. FAITHFUL
  2. RUBY SANDS
  3. BINTBOSSOM (FR)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ENCORE had been going the right way prior to having excuses on her latest outing, so she is taken to bounce back to winning ways for her leading yard. Wise Crack gained reward for his consistency when scoring over C&D earlier this month and can remain competitive, with his old rival Noelies Dream also in the mix.

  1. ENCORE (FR)
  2. WISE CRACK (IRE)
  3. NOELIES DREAM

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GO VICTOR has taken his form up a notch in cheekpieces last 3 starts, winning twice before runner-up here on his latest outing. That was only his second run on all-weather and he is fancied to add to his tally, at the chief expense of the in-form Kings Merchant. Mr Dreamseller completes the shortlist.

  1. GO VICTOR (IRE)
  2. KINGS MERCHANT
  3. MR DREAMSELLER

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
HENRIETTE RONNER ran better than for a while when second at Nottingham in July and, having since joined a yard which does well with new recruits, she could be ready to take advantage of her reduced mark. 5-time C&D winner Tomorrow Day arrives in good form and is feared most, ahead of Lord Abama.

  1. HENRIETTE RONNER
  2. TOMORROW DAY
  3. LORD ABAMA (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
HERAKLES should be spot on for this following a couple of recent spins here and may well land a fourth C&D success. Simba's Pride also looks interesting given the forecast strong pace, and he heads the dangers along with Southwell specialist Toptime, who could go well on just his second start at this track. Believeinmenow and Sunday River complete the shortlist for this wide-open sprint.

  1. HERAKLES (IRE)
  2. SIMBA'S PRIDE
  3. TOPTIME

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
CONCERT BOY has a good record in this grade here and may resume winning ways off a quick turnaround. Barleybrown will probably be knocking on the door again, with Haltonwood one of a number who appeal off slipping marks.

  1. CONCERT BOY (IRE)
  2. BARLEYBROWN
  3. HALTONWOOD (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BARBURY BOY found only an odds-on favourite too strong on his hurdling debut at Plumpton recently so, with improvement on the cards, Alan King's charge gets the vote to go one better. The penalised Thisonesforyou looks an obvious threat having made the perfect start for new connections earlier in the month, with Aukus and Pantile's Gift taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. BARBURY BOY
  2. THISONESFORYOU
  3. AUKUS (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling/EBF Stallions 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A golden opportunity for STARS ALIGNING to make a winning start over hurdles. Thatsnotmyname and Padel Whacker can battle it out for second.

  1. STARS ALIGNING
  2. THATSNOTMYNAME
  3. PADEL WHACKER

races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DANCE AND GLANCE is handily treated on his Swinton Hurdle placing and, with the yard in form and improvement expected over fences, he is selected to make the breakthrough, with last-time-out winner Bond Broker feared most on account of his experience and Cinquenta respected despite effectively making his chase debut.

  1. DANCE AND GLANCE
  2. BOND BROKER (IRE)
  3. CINQUENTA (FR)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A tricky betting race with a few likely to have one eye on the Pertemps Final itself. ROAD TO WEMBLEY has enjoyed a fine year over hurdles and may be rewarded with a fourth victory. Ernest Gray could make a bold bid to defy a career-high mark, with East India Express very much respected given his record around here.

  1. ROAD TO WEMBLEY
  2. ERNEST GRAY (IRE)
  3. EAST INDIA EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Lilies Mares' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good opportunity for likeable TAKE NO CHANCES to snap a losing sequence stretching back to early-2025. Hollygrove Cha Cha may well get the run of the race, and she just edges Jackie Hobbs for next best.

  1. TAKE NO CHANCES (IRE)
  2. HOLLYGROVE CHA CHA (IRE)
  3. JACKIE HOBBS

races.name: CopyBet Supporting UK Horse Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KING CALIFET has few miles on the clock but was most progressive last season and can make a successful return. Tapley has made a fine start for this yard this autumn and may prove the main danger.

  1. KING CALIFET (IRE)
  2. TAPLEY
  3. FIERCE WARRIOR (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WOODSTOCK CITY has made a bright start for Olly Murphy, and he's narrowly preferred to interesting stable-switcher Gordon Grey. Gallivanted heads the remainder in a competitive conditionals handicap.

  1. WOODSTOCK CITY
  2. GORDON GREY (IRE)
  3. GALLIVANTED (FR)

races.name: Bangor-On-Dee 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STARMOUNT jumped really well when dominating 2 Wetherby novice hurdles from the front last season and he can make a winning chase debut at the chief expense of Le Beau Madrik, who clearly benefited from his initial chase experience at Wetherby last time.

  1. STARMOUNT (IRE)
  2. LE BEAU MADRIK (FR)
  3. FIERCELY PROUD (IRE)

races.name: Boat At Erbistock Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AIR APPARENT appeals as a potentially useful sort in this sphere and he's hard to oppose able to race unpenalised for last week's Carlisle success. Kartoon And Co showed plenty to work on despite a near 3-year absence on his chase debut and can improve on that effort, with Ffos Las winner Gustapof completing the shortlist.

  1. AIR APPARENT (IRE)
  2. KARTOON AND CO (FR)
  3. GUSTAPOF (FR)

races.name: Bangor-On-Dee Memberships Now On Sale Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive affair but HARD DEALT makes plenty of appeal just 4 days on from making a winning chase debut at Warwick, a quick turnaround only a minor concern given the ease of that success. Dig Deep should make a superior chaser to a hurdler and rates as an interesting chase newcomer, with Perth winner Berkenshtaaap also considered in his hat-trick bid.

  1. HARD DEALT (IRE)
  2. DIG DEEP (IRE)
  3. BERKENSHTAAAP (IRE)

races.name: Wrexham Lager Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Those with chase experience look of most interest here, with ESCORT'KHEOPS chief amongst them after his third here last month. Crystello will be suited by the return to 3m and rates as a potential improver, with Knead A Win also meriting respect on his chase bow.

  1. ESCORT'KHEOPS (FR)
  2. CRYSTELLO (IRE)
  3. KNEAD A WIN (FR)

races.name: Outerspace Group 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JETZET made a promising start over hurdles at Southwell 3 weeks ago, looking sure to be suited by this longer trip, and he gets the vote. Grande J was a 16-length winner of a point in Ireland in February and makes plenty of appeal, with Hunting Call another to note.

  1. JETZET (IRE)
  2. GRANDE J (IRE)
  3. HUNTING CALL (IRE)

races.name: Mount Vines Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MILLE ET UNE VIES was Grade 3-placed in France and, while slightly disappointing at Cheltenham in March after 10 months off, this is a much softer assignment and she is likely to prove hard to beat, with Aeropress feared most after a promising hurdles debut at Worcester and Perfect Package a newcomer to note from an in-form yard.

  1. MILLE ET UNE VIES (FR)
  2. AEROPRESS (IRE)
  3. PERFECT PACKAGE (FR)

races.name: Festive Meeting Saturday 28th November 'Newcomers' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
No form to go at and the betting should be revealing, with CAVEMAN and Cross Allegation the most appealing runners on paper.

  1. CAVEMAN (IRE)
  2. CROSS ALLEGATION (IRE)
  3. GHOST FACE (IRE)

races.name: President Herve de la Brosse Handicap Hurdle
Gilles Tartoue- Challenge de l'Obstacle Equinaxy (Prix J. Brossais) Chase
Race 1 - New Mexico Classic Distaff Stakes
Race 3 - New Mexico Classic Juvenile Stakes
Race 4 - New Mexico Classic Lassie Stakes
Race 7 - New Mexico Classic Sprint Stakes
Race 9 - Peppers Pride New Mexico Classic Stakes
Race 10 - Rocky Gulch New Mexico Classic Stakes
Race 8 - Hollywood Gaming Mahoning Distaff Stakes
Race 9 - Cheryl S. White Memorial Stakes

nap.status_message: Moderate pick - 15.1 pts over the second
